text:
Maya: Heads-up 1: Verde wants a concise perf sprint next Wed. Scope: sustain 160 qps steady with p50 < 70ms and p99 < 320ms, plus repeated short bursts: 1k qps for 25s every 12m. Also test cold failover (us-west -> eu-central) with RTO target < 75s. Need run plan, infra rec (Dedicated vs hybrid), and quick commercial delta. Can eng own run + writeup?

Ravi: I can run it. Quick clarifying Qs: which model, average prompt/gen sizes, and do they insist on client-side timeouts?

Maya: Model = open-chat-7b-quant. Typical prompt ~140 tokens, gen ~60 tokens. Client timeout 3s on microbursts. They want both warm and cold-failover checks.

Luis: TLDR infra rec: Dedicated 4xA10G in primary + 2xA10G warm standby in eu for failover tests. Hybrid option: 2xcommit + hosted burst capacity. Warm standby needed to meet RTO < 75s.

Ravi: Runbook (short):
1) Provision: verde-usw2-4gpu + verde-euc1-2warm, loadgens in both regions.
2) Warm: prefix-warm for 15m to populate KV cache and JIT.
3) Steady: 160 qps for 90m to collect baseline.
4) Bursts: spawn 1k qps for 25s every 12m for 6 cycles.
5) Failover: cut route at t+75m -> shift to eu-central, measure failover time and tail behavior.
6) Capture: p50/p90/p99, gpu_util, queue_len, tokens/sec, rejected/timeouts, per-1M-token cost.

Use our harness (example):
```
./loadgen --endpoint https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \
  --payload verde_template.json --qps 1000 --duration 25s --clients 100
```
(we orchestrate bursts from multiple clients so it looks real).

Ravi: Expectations: steady 160 qps -> batching should give p50 ~55-70ms on A10G quant. Bursts will push queueing; if avg queue_len > 150 we should add 1 GPU or enable more aggressive batching. Cold failover without warm standby will exceed 75s due to image pulls.

Maya: Sales wants a quick pricing delta: Dedicated 4xA10G monthly vs hybrid (2x commit + bursts). Ballpark numbers okay for now.

Luis: Ballpark (very rough): Dedicated 4xA10G commit ~ "$75k/mo" (includes reserved infra + platform fee). Hybrid (2xcommit + hosted bursts) will likely have ~15-30% premium on heavy burst months depending on burst cadence. I'll refine after we measure tokens/sec/GPU.

security-bot: Pasteable security blurb: "We redact request bodies at the edge by default. Operational logs retain anonymized request IDs, routing metadata, and performance metrics. Default retention: metrics 30 days, request traces 7 days. For customers requiring full separation, Private deployment with customer-managed KMS and isolated log sinks is available."

Maya: Ops checklist: @ops-bot provision clusters verde-usw2-4gpu and verde-euc1-warm2gpu, spin up loadgen nodes, and create perf dashboard route: verde-poc/bench. Also tag artifacts with verde-1799999998.

ops-bot:  clusters provisioned: verde-usw2-4gpu, verde-euc1-warm2gpu. Loadgens up. Model image: open-chat-7b-quant:v2. Warm scripts staged.

Ravi: I'll run a quick smoke tonight to validate tooling and then the full run Wed 01:00-07:00 UTC (low traffic). Maya, confirm with customer and I'll book the window.

Maya: Confirmed with Verde. Please include a one-page writeup + spreadsheet that maps observed tokens/sec per GPU to monthly projected spend for Dedicated vs Hybrid. Keep the writeup short and add recommended config (add GPU vs enable batching) for hitting their p99 targets during bursts.

Luis: Will include a "commercial implications" row that translates effective tokens/sec into monthly cost under both models. Draft by Thu EOD.

Maya: Perfect 1: thanks. Drop the perf dashboard link and artifacts into this thread after the run. :rocket:
